$description: Moshi Typography v0.1 primitive font families, weights, baseline sizes, absolute line heights and tracking. Platform-aware, DTCG-inspired internal JSON; pt/sp/em string dimensions and explicit absolute line heights are not DTCG 2025.10 typography-compliant.

$extensions.moshi.note: Only baseline values: implement Dynamic Type and nonlinear native font scaling in consuming adapters; do not cap accessibility text size.

sans.$description: Inter is preferred when provided by the consumer; Moshi does not bundle or load it.

mono.$description: Use the host platform's available monospace fonts.

sans.$description: Symbolic native font identifier: resolve via UIFont.systemFont / SwiftUI .system.

mono.$description: Symbolic native monospace identifier: resolve via UIFont.monospacedSystemFont or SwiftUI .system(.body,design:.monospaced).

bold.$description: Use sparingly; controlled override, not a default semantic style.
